content.short: Manteca provides financial infrastructure for fintechs building across Latin America.
content.description: Manteca supplies financial infrastructure for Latin American fintechs, covering the plumbing needed to move between local currencies and crypto in the region. World's official World Chain ecosystem directory lists it among the network's payments partners. Regional payment rails are what let a global network actually connect to local bank accounts and currencies.
